ways.label: Lake Alta Track

start.name: road behind the Remarkables ski field buildings
start.quote: The track begins on the road behind the Remarkables ski field buildings

via.name: top of the Alta Chairlift
via.quote: the top of the Alta Chairlift

evidence: The track begins on the road behind the Remarkables ski field buildings and follows a ski field road to the top of the Alta Chairlift.
From there, cairns and flagstones mark the way through alpine wetlands, up to the glacial cirque.

doubts: Start ref F1 (unnamed track meeting the Remarkables Ski Field Access Road) is the only road end listed and fits 'the road behind the Remarkables ski field buildings', but is not named by the text. The lift ends (1865 m, 1933 m) do not clearly match the 'Alta Chairlift' top, so no ref. Shape is out and back from DOC's distance 'return via same track'. Winter route through the ski field differs and is not recorded as a way.
